 Live Reporting
 Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular CLOSE! published at 32 mins 32 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Wesley Fofana has a lapse in concentration and has his pocket picked by Amad.
 The United winger is through on goal but he takes too long to shoot and Mike Penders forces the corner. 
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:01 GMT 13:01 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Welbeck will come on late in the game to haunt his former side, won't he?
 Michael, Manchester 
 I still scratch my head over the fact Louis van Gaal got rid of Welbeck!
 Mart 
 219 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 30 mins 30 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Bruno Fernandes finds Amad in space about 20 yards from goal and he decides to have a go, forcing Mike Penders into the save. 
 121 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Chelsea supporters are getting edgy published at 13:00 GMT 13:00 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport Chelsea reporter 
 Chelsea fans are getting edgy after Cole Palmer gives it away on the edge of the box and Man United go close again. 
 The defence isn't looking right for either team, but there is pressure on Chelsea too here after the loss at home to Tottenham last week. 
 169 59 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 12:59 GMT 12:59 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Image source, PA Media Whisper it quietly, but United are holding their own and creating some nice chances.
Not sure if they're showing enough to win. But would a point away be good enough?
 Dino, High Wycombe 
 267 208 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Mbeumo should have kept going' published at 12:58 GMT 12:58 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 I just think there's a doubt in Bryan Mbeumo's mind whether it's coming in first time, does he just stop at the last minute? He just doubted it when he should keep going. 
 Its been a good open game so far from both sides. 
 125 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 27 mins 27 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Estevao is left in a heap by former Chelsea team-mate Andrey Santos but still no punishment is dished out. 
 94 149 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Image source, Reuters You'd have to say United are the better side here. 
 Stamford Bridge is very, very quiet as a result. 
 338 221 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Inches away!
 Bruno Fernandes looks on it as he receives the ball in the box and squares for Bryan Mbeumo but it's a yard in front of him. 
 130 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'A really poor touch' published at 12:55 GMT 12:55 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 A brilliant pass from Andrey Santos early on. This is a big chance and what a poor touch from Matheus Cunha, really poor. 
 124 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Bruno Fernandes is lucky to get away without a yellow card after chopping down Josh Acheampong. 
 97 148 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Fernandes' miss published at 12:54 GMT 12:54 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Man Utd 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Manchester United reporter at Stamford Bridge 
 Image source, Getty Images Bruno Fernandes could not have wished for a better opportunity than that.
 Bryan Mbeumo's pass from the touchline was perfect.
 Fernandes controlled and while he was running at pace, a player of his ability should be able to control his shot.
 Sadly for Manchester United it was way off target. Michael Carrick talks about fine margins. How important a goal that would have been.
 178 68 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Matheus Cunha's first touch lets him down as he looks to get his shot off but Levi Colwill has great recovery pace to get back in. 
 48 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 There's a bit of pinball in the box and it bounces off the head of Wesley Fofana before Senne Lammens gathers. 
 86 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 A gap opens for Josh Acheampong in the United box and he drives one towards goal but it's blocked behind for another Chelsea corner. 
 88 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The break is fantastic' published at 12:52 GMT 12:52 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Image source, Reuters Everything about it is brilliant, the break is fantastic, Bryan Mbeumo does the right thing holding the ball. 
 It's just Bruno Fernades' final touch that isn't spot on. 
 179 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12:51 GMT 12:51 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Mark Schwarzer 
Former Chelsea goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Stamford Bridge 
 Bryan Mbeumo picks out Bruno Fernandes and his first touch isn't the one which we are normally accustomed to. Fernandes has to at the very least hit the target. 
 106 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Alonso believes in Rogers' published at 12:51 GMT 12:51 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Xabi Alonso named Morgan Rogers as one of the players who's got fight and tenacity, when a manager says that he really believes in that players. 
 92 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Image source, PA Media United don't look great at the back at all but they just about scramble the free-kick clear and away Bryan Mbeumo goes down the right. 
 He finds Bruno Fernandes with a great ball but he skies horribly. 
 Big, big chance. 
 181 111 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Fans respond to Estevao published at 12:49 GMT 12:49 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Manchester United 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport Chelsea reporter 
 There are chants of "Steve-o", the nickname of Estevao Willian among the Chelsea faithful at Stamford Bridge.
 The young attacker is hugely popular with supporters here, and his omission from Chelsea's line-ups under Xabi Alonso has been a source of criticism for the new manager.
